description: Check a plan before booking: timing problems (a flight home too early for the ship, a stop that makes them late), what's still missing (hotel, flight times), rides that can't be booked yet, the cost so far line by line, hotel options, and booking_order: every part to book (the trip, the flight, the hotel, the rides; any order, a suggested next), what's done, and which rides still wait for the flight, hotel or sailing they connect to. Read-only.
name: check_plan
title: Check a trip plan
